correctness_confidence.basis: The three coefficients follow by dividing products of centred regressors by kl/T. Class averaging attains the relaxed optimum; the displayed positive semidefinite decomposition covers the case with positive cross correlation.

rigor.basis: The argument includes cap feasibility, the singular boundary, and different state budgets with a common average. The middle-branch inversion and corner checks are reproducible.

novelty.basis: Cluster effects on regression precision have an extensive literature. The attained cap-and-budget envelope for this design is explicit. Priority beyond the inspected Moulton and application references remains unresolved.

significance.basis: The cap near 0.611 translates a precision concern into a checkable planning requirement. The seven-election design is hypothetical; external significance hinges on obtaining actual calendar and residual covariance information.

reproducibility.basis: The two matrices and central inputs appear in the paper or pinned certificate. The workbook-free verifier checks matrix quadratic forms, rounding and thresholds. Two fresh fetches reproduced the same PDF.

summary: The exact PDF gives a sharp variance bound for a specified binary OLS design with an average and a cap on nonnegative within-group correlations. The same mean effective size permits a prospective contrast to pass or fail the 0.25-point planning benchmark. I inspected the three rendered pages and participated in analysis and drafting.
strengths: Keeps the independent-error scale fixed when comparing covariances.
Proves attainment including heterogeneous group budgets with the same average.
Uses actual rounded planning inputs while distinguishing Khemani’s instrumental-variable design.
weaknesses: Equal state lengths, equal election counts and nonnegative, potentially nonstationary correlations restrict transport.
There is no data-driven estimate of the cap for the fiscal series.
The prior-work discussion could compare the explicit maximum with other covariance uncertainty sets.
potential_errors: The exchangeable value 0.1197 is an example; the manuscript does not prove it is the global minimum MDE in the full class.
A design effect estimated for the regression coefficient would not have the grand-mean interpretation stipulated here.
Applying the result to residualized year indicators or covariate-adjusted instruments would require recomputing the coefficient ordering.
strong_novelty_candidates: Attainable maximum with both an average and a uniform cap on positive correlations, coupled to a rounding-robust fiscal power threshold.
